email.subject: Redline Auto Care's mobile site
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I checked Redline Auto Care's site and noticed it isn't set up for mobile. Most people searching for an auto shop nearby do it on their phone, and a page that's hard to tap or read on mobile usually sends them straight to the next search result. Your pages are also slow to load because of oversized images, which adds to that drop-off.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee, no ongoing contract. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you the specific pages and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
